original.description: Portrait of Paul Georg von Rennenkampf (1854–1918), Baltic German general in Russian service.

caption: Paul von Rennenkampf, commander of the Russian First Army in East Prussia in August 1914 — the army that did not come to Samsonov’s help at Tannenberg.
credit: Original photograph: photographer not identified, c. 1910; via Wikimedia Commons (record cites Gallica / Bibliothèque nationale de France); public domain.
